phase: CD-3B — Economic / Forward Validation (second sublayer of CD-3)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04: future outcomes for VALIDATION only; distributions not means; matched baseline mandatory; episode-level independence; state continuation >= returns in importance; EARLY_BUILD not 吸筹
event_classes: CD-2C path labels FADING / EXPANSION / NARROWING / BUILDING (frozen definitions from cd2b2c_preregistration; NOT re-tuned)
episode_definition_frozen: per sector: consecutive days carrying the SAME path label collapse into one episode (>=1 gap day breaks it); T_e = first day of episode; report event_days, episodes, distinct sectors, distinct calendar years

outcomes_frozen.forward_sector_rel_return_eq: sum of (sector_eq - mkt_eq) over T_e+1..T_e+H (compounded: prod(1+sector_eq)/prod(1+mkt_eq)-1)
outcomes_frozen.forward_max_relative_drawdown: min over horizon of (cum sector rel return from T_e); recorded as negative number

state_continuation.EXPANSION: share of horizon days with base=BROAD_STRENGTH
state_continuation.NARROWING: P(FADING path label appears within horizon)
state_continuation.BUILDING: P(EXPANSION path label appears within horizon)

outcomes_frozen.incomplete_horizons: if data ends inside horizon, mark available_days and keep row in separate 'truncated' list (excluded from headline stats, reported separately)

matching_axes: same market-regime tercile (market 20d eq return, tercile edges fit on dev window)
matched_baseline_frozen.pool_exclusion: baseline days exclude any day carrying ANY path label and exclude days within 5 sessions after any episode T_e of any label (avoid event contamination)
matched_baseline_frozen.comparison: full distribution of matched pool vs episode outcomes; stats = median/q25/q75/P(>0)/P(<q10-of-pool)/std; no sampling — use entire matched pool
matched_baseline_frozen.regime_tercile_edges: fit on dev 2021-2023, frozen, applied to holdout

prohibited: using forward outcomes to redefine episodes/labels/features
